papers.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
papers.abstract: Repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering with 119 tasks across 20 domains, revealing failure mechanisms in coding agents including deficits in scientific knowledge, surface-level repairs, and generalization failures.

papers.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
papers.abstract: Framework leveraging multi-turn user simulation and governance layers to sustain skill evolution through trustworthy feedback gradients, surpassing self-reflection methods by 23 points across production skills.

papers.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
papers.abstract: Continuous structural evolution framework using Dual-DAG architectural state for generating complete software projects, improving functionality coverage by up to 20 points over repository-planning baselines.

papers.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Production-ready sparse attention implementation achieving 47.26x speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 128K context with mean correction term, GPU optimization, and framework integration for practical deployment.

papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.abstract: Investigation of fine-tuning frontier models to reason in Greek reveals SFT shifts reasoning into target language while RL with verifiable rewards fixes formatting defects, with minimal accuracy changes.

papers.title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models
papers.abstract: Methodology revealing that high-performing speech models reproduce benchmark transcripts despite contradictory audio, demonstrating benchmark-conditioned behaviors inflate scores without improving real-world transcription.

papers.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
papers.abstract: Three-stage framework converting document corpora into parametric knowledge for retrieval-free QA, achieving 3.6 point domain accuracy gains while recovering general capabilities across model families.

papers.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement
papers.abstract: Study of test-time learning through iterative feedback loops showing consistent improvements over zero-shot baselines with 5.6% gains and 19% cost reduction using self and environmental feedback signals.

papers.title: τ₀-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
papers.abstract: Hierarchical vision-language-action model using world-model-guided search for subtask generation in long-horizon manipulation, trained on 40,115 hours of real-world data across multiple embodiments.

papers.title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
papers.abstract: Benchmark measuring execution boundary parsing errors in LLM coding agents, revealing matched scores hide substantial damages and revealing boundary disclosure recovers 30-61% performance.

cc_updates.body: Cost estimates now include the 1.1x US-only-inference premium for data-residency workspaces. Added the one-time fullscreen renderer offer on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other previously excluded setups. Added `/claude-api upgrade` to migrate Python projects from `anthropic` 0.x to 1.x. Cloud sessions: plugins synced from claude.ai now show as `name@synced`. Alpine/musl builds: native image paste, clipboard, and audio-capture add-ons now load. Fixed Bedrock streaming behind proxies that strip the response Content-Type header. Fixed Claude Code hanging at startup behind an HTTPS proxy when using Bedrock with an SSO profile. Fixed Edit and Write calls pausing in JetBrains IDE terminals.

Added a `keybindingFlavor` setting: set it to `readline` to make Ctrl+W in the prompt delete back to the previous whitespace, as in Bash. Plugin marketplaces: `headersHelper` on a url marketplace or a catalog entry runs a command that mints HTTP headers. Added `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>`. Fixed unbounded memory growth in long interactive sessions: subagent tool results are now released once they leave the recent display window. Fixed custom, project, and plugin output styles drifting back to the default voice mid-session.

Fixed prompt caching for sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL. Added a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration, while doing the work just as thoroughly. Select it under Output style in /config.
